WITH hand_counts AS (
    SELECT p.throws, COUNT(DISTINCT pa.player_id) AS player_count
    FROM player_award AS pa
    JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = pa.player_id
    GROUP BY p.throws
), hand_shares AS (
    SELECT throws, player_count,
           1.0 * player_count / SUM(player_count) OVER () AS share
    FROM hand_counts
), above_average AS (
    SELECT throws, player_count, share
    FROM hand_shares
    WHERE share > (SELECT AVG(share) FROM hand_shares)
)
SELECT SUM(player_count) AS total_count,
       AVG(share) AS average_share,
       AVG(share - (SELECT AVG(share) FROM hand_shares)) AS average_excess_share
FROM above_average

assumptions.assumption: A blank hand is represented as an empty string and is grouped separately from NULL; each distinct player_id is counted once within that hand group.
